name: Pokedex Sprites (HGSS)
description: Replaces the Pokedex art (list-view preview and the full entry page) with HeartGold/SoulSilver-style sprites for all 151 species. Battle, party summary, evolution, Hall of Fame, and every other sprite site are untouched -- only the pokemon.sprite hook's dex-kind path is answered. This 0.2.0 build is a DIAGNOSTIC: it adds three temporary SPR rows to the START menu reporting whether the sprite hook fired and what species id it saw, to find why 0.1.0 changed nothing. Fan-art sprite swap sourced from Bulbagarden Archives; for personal use.
